rationale: The workflow already caches pip dependencies via actions/setup-python@v4 with cache: pip and cache-dependency-path: pyproject.toml, which is equivalent to the actions/cache@v4 pip dependency cache supported by the measured P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE / P-LIT-GHA-CACHE evidence. Adding a duplicate cache step is contraindicated by that pattern ("An equivalent cache already exists"), and the measured experiments show cache benefit that is already realized in this workflow. The matrix contains a single OS/Python combination, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST would cancel no additional work. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is simulation-estimate evidence and touches required-check/branch-protection semantics (required_checks status is not_verified), so it is not applied without a separate review. No supported, non-redundant optimization remains that preserves intended coverage.
